2025-08-28.title: First Practice @ The Front
2025-08-28.about: Come join us for our FIRST fall practice! This event is FREE for all Utah Climbing Team members. Sign up and find more details on our Discord!

2025-09-03.title: Second Practice @ BP
2025-09-03.about: Come join us for our SECOND fall practice! Find more details on our Discord!

2025-09-07.title: LAST DAY TO SIGN UP!
2025-09-07.about: Sign-up forms must be completed by the 7th to be added to the Utah Climbing Team roster and receive industry membership rates at Momentum, The Front, and Bouldering Project. You can still join after the 7th and participate in practices, events, and trips, but you will NOT receive the reduced membership rates.

2025-09-19.title: BP MOVIE NIGHT
2025-09-19.about: Join us for our first Movie Night at BP! Bring your favorite snacks, popcorn, blankets, and chairs, and get comfy. We’ll be watching some climbing videos (or a full climbing movie) to get psyched! 🎥🍿 More info in discord!

2025-09-20.title: LCC Day
2025-09-20.about: Our first outdoor day trip to LCC! Bring your climbing gear and stoke. More details on Discord!!

2025-09-21.title: LAST DAY TO UPGRADE FROM REC TEAM TO COMP TEAM
2025-09-21.about: Sunday is the LAST day to upgrade from the Rec Team to the Comp Team. Don't miss your chance to compete this semester!

2025-09-23.title: Summit Sesh!
2025-09-23.about: Come climb with us! The Utah Climbing Team is teaming up with the Freeskiers and Outdoor Industry Club for a fun community climbing session right here on campus. Whether you’re new to climbing or a seasoned crusher, this is a great chance to meet new people, try some routes, and share the stoke. More details in the discord coming soon!

2025-10-04.title: Fall Break Trip to Joe’s Valley
2025-10-04.about: Join us for our Fall Break climbing trip to Joe’s Valley! Come for a day or stay the whole week. Camping and bouldering with the team! More info on time, dates, location, etc. will be posted soon!

2025-10-16.title: Comp Team Dinner
2025-10-16.about: A team dinner for Comp Team members to relax, enjoy good food, receive important updates about upcoming events later this year, and celebrate the season together!

2025-10-26.title: Big Cottonwood Rope Day
2025-10-26.location: Big Cottonwood Canyon (Meet at BCC Park and Ride)
2025-10-26.about: Outdoor climbing day on ropes in collaboration with Backcountry Squatters! Meet at the Big Cottonwood Park and Ride at 12 p.m. We'll head to the crag shortly after. Please fill out the attendance form and note that climbing involves inherent risk.

2025-11-15.title: Boulderfest 2025
2025-11-15.location: Bouldering Project – The Granary, Salt Lake City, UT
2025-11-15.about: Salt Lake City’s biggest community climbing competition returns! An electric, all-day celebration featuring an all-levels climbing comp, open finals, music, food trucks, raffles, vendor market, games, and community connection. Beginners through pros are welcome.

2025-11-22.title: The Quarry - QE Bouldering Competition
2025-11-22.location: The Quarry Indoor Climbing Center, Ogden, UT
2025-11-22.about: Exclusive event for college & university climbing teams! Collegiate comp with USU, UTU, UVU, and BYU! This comp event WILL count as a QE! For more information on how to sign up or if you have any question - Check the Discord!!

2025-11-23.title: Comp Training Day
2025-11-23.about: Focused training session for comp team members only. High intensity drills, coordination problems, and competition prep.

2025-12-03.title: LAST PRACTICE OF THE SEMESTER!
2025-12-03.location: Our final climb of the semester! Come send hard, celebrate the season, and finish strong with the whole crew! Come to Momentum Indoor Climbing Millcreek!!
